section_summary.extract_value: This section details between-sex comparisons for a study involving 301 participants. It reports no significant sex differences in mean age and self-esteem, but significant differences in mean BMI. A one-way ANCOVA on BAS scores, with BMI as a covariate, revealed a significant effect of sex, suggesting men have more positive body appreciation than women.
